newsitem.title: UK: Sears shares edge lower as BZW downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Sears shares edge lower as BZW downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Sears Plc nudged lower on Wednesday as analysts at BZW cut the retail group, which owns the Selfridges department store in central London, to "sell" from "hold," dealers said.
The stock was down 1-1/2p at 68-1/2 by 1058 GMT in volume of 347,022 shares.
BZW's downgrade came after a gloomy statement at Tuesday's annual shareholders' meeting, dealers said. BZW also cut its current-year pre-tax profit estimate to 60.5 million stg from 75.0 million.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.

Sears announced the demerger of Selfridges and the departure of its chief executive Liam Strong in late April but the move has failed to inspire the shares, which have lately slipped back to below their level of 78p before the restructuring was announced.
